title: Currency
description: ISO 4217 currency code. Duplicated identically in finance/schemas/common — quote and finance are separate bounded contexts and neither $refs the other's schemas (see steps/4_consolidate_entities.md), so each context keeps its own copy. Adopted here from quote's CreateQuoteRequest, the only place this pattern was previously enforced; every other currency field in this project was a bare unconstrained string before this consolidation.
